name: youtube-declutter-dev
description: Dev-only tooling for the YouTube Declutter extension (tests + packaging). Never shipped in the extension.

scripts.package:zip: npm run package && cd dist && find . -type f -exec touch -t 198001010000 {} + && rm -f ../yt-declutter-$npm_package_version.zip && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | zip -X -q ../yt-declutter-$npm_package_version.zip -@ && cd .. && echo "wrote yt-declutter-$npm_package_version.zip (deterministic: sorted entries, fixed mtimes)"
